form.notes: Declared for spec 080 T052. The credit allowed (line 12) is limited by the regular tax and AMT less other credits — a computation. Form 1097-BTC box 1 and the K-1 bond-credit codes are its inputs (Part III); the same credit amount is ALSO interest income on a Form 1099-INT or 1099-OID, which is placed as printed.
